35.measure_note: This schedule is NOT the county's printed grid form - it is the filer's own TYPED portrait sheet with no printed rules at all, so there is no row grid to detect (rowbands finds only text runs). The bands are therefore measured from the page itself in the only way it offers: a dark-run probe restricted to the AMOUNT column x-window (48-58%) returns one run per printed entry line at 18.09 / 22.86 / 27.68 pct (plus 16.50 = the grey scan bar, 12.05-13.43 = the 'Amount' header and 34.14 = the Total line, all excluded), and each band is that measured centre +/- 0.90 pct. Each entry occupies three printed lines (name, street, city/state) but only the first carries the amount, which is the line banded here. The amount column's x band 50.50-57.50 is the right-aligned figure block. PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops at row 1 (4,000.00) and row 3 (150.00).

notes: SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: this filing's COVER (p34) is handwritten on the county's 2022 3-line form, but BOTH SCHEDULES ARE THE FILER'S OWN TYPED SUBSTITUTE SHEETS - portrait, no printed grid, headed 'Form A: Campaign Financial Report 2022 / Itemized Report of Contributions' and 'Form B: ... Itemized Report of Expenditures', with an extra unheaded column to the right of Amount carrying '(in-kind)' tags. They are NOT the county's rotated landscape grid sheets used by every other 2022 filing read in this wave, which is why neither page has any detectable row grid and the frames are measured from the printed text lines instead. Both schedules are PERIOD-scoped (This Report), not cumulative: the cover opens from 41,727.54 contributions / 38,484.39 expenditures already raised and spent earlier in the cycle, and none of that is itemized here. Form A itemizes 5,150.40 of which ALL 5,150.40 is in-kind; Form B itemizes 5,054.35 of in-kind outflow. The cover's line-3 'this report' figure 3,114.10 is written positive although the balance falls by it - the filer's sign convention, already recorded in the stated-totals cache and not adjusted. Contributor street addresses / PO box printed on Form A are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: city/state only).
